title: How to Operate a Handheld Sewing Machine - Tutorial
description:
Step by step instructions for how to operate a handheld sewing machine tutorial with all the best tips to help you be successful using this portable sewing machine. I am using the Handy Stitch brand in this video but many other brands are exactly the same. 
My aim is to provide the best education with this handheld sewing machine for anyone who has purchased this sewing machine and would like to know how to use it successfully. 

You can find this portable handheld sewing machine on Amazon https://www.amazon.com/gp/search/ref=as_li_qf_sp_sr_il_tl?ie=UTF8&tag=easysewiforbe-20&keywords=handy stitch handheld sewing machine&index=aps&camp=1789&creative=9325&linkCode=xm2&linkId=415c5b8c307d68834726242aaf5d4582 *Affiliate link
